components.name: Masthead
components.description: Compact identity and profile navigation at the top of the catalogue.
components.html: ReelRankLetterboxd profile ↗
components.css: .ds-nav { height: 80px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.055em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-profile { color: var(--control-ink); font: 11px var(--mono); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible, .ds-profile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-wordmark:focus-visible, .ds-profile:focus-visible { outline-color: #c3df93; } }

components.name: Selected Filter
components.description: A compact active state for watched-status filtering.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--filter-active); color: var(--filter-active-ink); cursor: pointer; font: 11px var(--sans); transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline-color: #c3df93; } }

components.name: Catalogue Search
components.description: A quiet single-line search field with a clear keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-search { height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-search span, .ds-search kbd { color: var(--muted); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 11px var(--sans); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.description: A filterable genre tag with a clear pressed state.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--control-ink); cursor: pointer; font: 9px var(--sans); } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--forest); background: var(--filter-active); color: var(--filter-active-ink); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-setup { width: min(620px, 100%); padding: clamp(26px, 6vw, 54px); border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px #24251d10; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-setup strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 32px; font-size: 21px; } .ds-setup h2 { margin: 0; font: 500 clamp(38px, 7vw, 60px)/1.05 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.055em; } .ds-setup p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-setup a { color: var(--forest); font: 11px var(--mono); text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-setup a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-hero { min-height: 336px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 34px 8.2%; background: var(--forest); color: #f6f3e9; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-hero::before { position: absolute; inset: 14px; border: 1px solid #d4e6c72b; content: ''; pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-hero h1 { margin: 0; font: 500 clamp(34px, 7vw, 78px)/.99 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -.065em; } .ds-hero em { color: var(--green); font: italic 500 1em var(--serif); } .ds-hero-tagline { margin: 10px 0 16px; color: #c6d7b0; font: 12px/1.4 var(--mono); } .ds-hero-browse { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--green); background: var(--green); color: #243d31; font: 12px var(--mono); text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero-browse:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd6446; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-hero-stamp { max-width: 158px; color: #c3d89c; font: italic 21px var(--serif); text-align: center; }

components.name: Programme Note
components.description: A quiet editorial annotation with a terracotta edge.
components.html:
PROGRAMME NOTE

Films are ranked by appearances across liked lists.
components.css: .ds-note { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-left: 2px solid var(--orange); background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--muted); font: 9px/1.5 var(--mono); } .ds-note strong { color: var(--rust-ink); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-note p { margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
ReelRank feels like a cinephile’s home: warm, comfortable, and organized around a personal catalogue. Its visual language pairs a lived-in paper palette with evergreen framing, serif film titles, and small mono labels that make rankings and provenance easy to scan.

The interface balances a poster wall’s immediacy with a ledger’s precision. Film artwork leads the browsing view; the ledger makes a large catalogue easier to compare. The same editorial rhythm carries into compact controls, expandable details, and a dedicated dark palette.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and deep evergreen framing
Playfair Display headlines alongside DM Sans reading text and DM Mono metadata
Poster-led browsing balanced by a compact, sortable ledger
Mostly flat surfaces with depth reserved for overlays

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep terracotta and lichen as accents around evergreen structure; don’t let them replace the quiet paper and forest base.

rules.name: The Three-Face Rule
rules.body: Use Playfair Display for expressive hierarchy, DM Sans for reading, and DM Mono for compact catalogue data; don’t add a fourth type family.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep resting catalogue surfaces flat; reserve stronger depth for controls that open above surrounding content.

dos: Do keep poster artwork as the leading image in poster-wall mode.
Do preserve the light and dark themes through the system color-scheme preference.
Do use mono type for compact metadata and serif type for film titles and editorial headings.
Do keep the catalogue flat at rest and use shadows for raised menus and dialogs.
donts: Don't turn catalogue rows into generic rounded cards; the poster wall and ledger have distinct, intentional structures.
Don't spread terracotta across broad surfaces; it is an accent to the paper-and-evergreen palette.
Don't remove the visible focus treatment from interactive controls.
